openesc-30-four-motors.title: Four motors in a ramp
openesc-30-four-motors.finding: All four motors hold 7545 to 7572 rpm at full throttle on 13 inch props; the clamp reads 89.3 A at 64 percent.
openesc-30-four-motors.chip: OpenESC-30x30, 4 motors, 13 inch rig, clamp reference

openesc-die-temp-ramp.title: Die temperature in a ramp
openesc-die-temp-ramp.finding: Die temperature climbs from 23 C to 156 C as clamp current rises to 39.8 A; telemetry peaks at 161 C.

openesc-shunt-vs-clamp.title: Current sense against clamp
openesc-shunt-vs-clamp.finding: At 80 percent the sense reads 11.6 A against 32.4 A on the clamp; at 100 percent it reads 64.7 A against 55.7 A.

openfc-lite-flight-die-temp.title: ESC die temperature in flight
openfc-lite-flight-die-temp.finding: The 8 inch on 8S reaches 116 C; the other three flights stay between 52.6 and 87.4 C.

openmotor-hold-esc-temp.title: ESC temperature per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-esc-temp.finding: The hottest of four die sensors reads 43 C at 10 percent and 53 C at 100 percent.
openmotor-hold-esc-temp.chip: One OpenMotor-2306, one 6S pack, cell calibrated to 1726 g

tile.detail: Hottest of 4 die sensors, only channel 1 driven

openmotor-hold-pack-voltage.title: Pack voltage per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-pack-voltage.finding: The 16:48 UTC pack sags from 23.9 V to 21.6 V across the holds; the 13:25 UTC pack reaches 19.3 V at 100 percent.
openmotor-hold-pack-voltage.chip: One OpenMotor-2306, one 6S pack, cell calibrated to 1726 g
